declarations.originalTitle: shares one Store root per project history inspection and rechecks each scan after metadata changes
declarations.behavior: 原Store root批量解析次数、元数据损坏及同一Hook epoch内重新观察全部保留。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle shares one Store root per project history inspection and rechecks each scan after metadata changes

declarations.originalTitle: closes a fully cancelled Run while retaining readable history and portable documents
declarations.behavior: 原cancelled封存、closed CAS拒绝、active/history分区及用户材料可读全部保留。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle closes a fully cancelled Run while retaining readable history and portable documents

declarations.originalTitle: keeps an unfinished Run active during explicit migration
declarations.behavior: 原unfinished保活动、不越权推进保留。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle keeps an unfinished Run active during explicit migration

declarations.originalTitle: never migrates on ordinary inspection and resumes explicit interrupted closure
declarations.behavior: 普通只读不封存；原显式中断闭合与幂等保留。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle never migrates on ordinary inspection and resumes explicit interrupted closure

declarations.originalTitle: defers closed history body corruption to explicit inspection while Hook reads only partition metadata
declarations.behavior: Hook只读分区不解析closed正文；named status和global Doctor必须拒绝损坏正文，已原RED→GREEN。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle defers closed history body corruption to explicit inspection while Hook reads only partition metadata

declarations.originalTitle: does not let a history owner hide an active checkpoint conflict
declarations.behavior: 历史owner不得隐藏活动checkpoint冲突，原记录不覆盖。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle does not let a history owner hide an active checkpoint conflict

declarations.originalTitle: recovers an interrupted owner publication through a new explicit doctor invocation
declarations.behavior: 同字节active/history owner双份普通读取拒绝，沿既有recover入口显式恢复并闭合，原RED→GREEN。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle recovers an interrupted owner publication through a new explicit doctor invocation

declarations.originalTitle: keeps an interrupted %s transaction visible and recovers it through explicit migration
declarations.behavior: 实际Store closing与reopening各保留中断可见、再恢复与重复调用。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle keeps an interrupted closing transaction visible and recovers it through explicit migration
Native terminal history lifecycle keeps an interrupted reopening transaction visible and recovers it through explicit migration

declarations.originalTitle: rejects same-revision content drift and unknown workflow definitions before closing
declarations.behavior: 原同revision内容漂移拒绝、未知当前definition拒绝且不闭合；未知定义文案调整为当前definition hash。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle rejects same-revision content drift and unknown workflow definitions before closing

declarations.originalTitle: restores a portable %s Run on another device without the original runtime or history partition
declarations.behavior: 另一设备无Runtime恢复保原Run ID/revision/状态/Actions/批准；比较实际portable checkpoint解码记录，不能要求live claimToken等于portable-*；cancelled共同repair直接正确闭合。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle restores a portable active Run on another device without the original runtime or history partition
Native terminal history lifecycle restores a portable cancelled Run on another device without the original runtime or history partition

declarations.originalTitle: migrates a stopped portable cancellation after its linked worktree is removed without changing evidence through %s
declarations.behavior: 真实linked worktree Shape批准→Builder领取→cancel，Git commit/merge并删除原worktree、CRLF便携文件；公共Doctor repair通过runtime/bundle两边界恢复原记录、重复、Hook无活动且源字节不变。停止回执要求退休；同一原title保持7targets中3IDs精确选择器。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle migrates a stopped portable cancellation after its linked worktree is removed without changing evidence through runtime
Native terminal history lifecycle migrates a stopped portable cancellation after its linked worktree is removed without changing evidence through bundle

declarations.originalTitle: does not shadow the %s authority in a registered source worktree
declarations.behavior: 旧自动跨worktree搜索退休；真实原始/较新source Run在显式本地取消恢复前后深等，不能冒称全局扫描仍存在。
currentFullNames: Native terminal history lifecycle preserves the original source authority when explicitly restoring a local cancellation
Native terminal history lifecycle preserves the newer source authority when explicitly restoring a local cancellation

declarations.originalTitle: rejects portable history import with %s without overwriting local evidence
declarations.behavior: 10分支逐一保留/转换，详guards映射；普通平台活动claim、无stop取消可恢复，真实坏数据无落地，root Child不冒充顶层，原本地权威无owner仍拒绝。Archive参数只保原SIMULATED名称损坏，无claim/事务/成功，非真实Archive义务。
